info.title: Liibra
info.summary: Open, primary-source access to Brazilian legal information, addressed by LexML URN.
info.description: Public, read-only HTTP surface for liibra.com.br. No authentication, API keys, or tokens: every endpoint is open. Documents are addressed by their canonical LexML URN (urn:lex:br:...). Legal text originates from official sources (LexML Brasil, Câmara dos Deputados Dados Abertos); every document page keeps attribution and a verification link — preserve them when reusing content. Liibra republishes primary sources and is not itself an authoritative source.

get.summary: Resolve a LexML URN to its Liibra document page
get.description: LexML-style compatibility entry point. Issues a permanent redirect to the URN-addressed document page at /doc/{urn}.

308.description: Permanent redirect to the URN-addressed document page.

get.description: Server-rendered HTML for the document identified by the LexML URN, with source attribution and a verification link to the official source.

200.description: The document page. Legal text is always in Portuguese; interface chrome follows the locale cookie or Accept-Language.

404.description: No document is known for this URN.
